content.question: What is the purpose of multi-head attention?
options: To process only the most important word in the sentence.
To use multiple attention heads that each learn to attend to different parts of the input, capturing different patterns and correlations.
To replace the encoder-decoder structure with a single layer.
To make the model slower but more accurate on short sequences.
content.answer: To use multiple attention heads that each learn to attend to different parts of the input, capturing different patterns and correlations.
